shouts.name: animal allegiance
shouts.desc: summons wild beasts to fight in your defense.

shouts.name: aura whisper
shouts.desc: reveals the life forces of all nearby entities through walls.

shouts.name: battle fury
shouts.desc: enchants nearby allies' weapons to attack faster.

shouts.name: become ethereal
shouts.desc: turns you ethereal, making you immune to all damage and unable to attack.

shouts.name: bend will
shouts.desc: bends stones, animals, people, and dragons to your will.

shouts.name: call dragon
shouts.desc: summons the dragon odahviing to fight alongside you.

shouts.name: call of valor
shouts.desc: summons a hero from sovngarde to aid you in combat.

shouts.name: clear skies
shouts.desc: clears away fog, mist, and bad weather with a touch of the clear skies.

shouts.name: cyclone
shouts.desc: creates a whirling cyclone that throws enemies into the air.

shouts.name: disarm
shouts.desc: rips weapons out of opponents' hands.

shouts.name: dismay
shouts.desc: sends a wave of terror that forces weak enemies to flee in panic

shouts.name: dragon aspect
shouts.desc: grants dragon armor, heavier physical blows, and stronger shouts once per day.

shouts.name: dragonrend
shouts.desc: forces flying dragons to land by lashing out at their souls.

shouts.name: drain vitality
shouts.desc: drains health, magicka, and stamina from targets over time.

shouts.name: elemental fury
shouts.desc: drastically surges weapon attack speed in a flurry of blows.

shouts.name: fire breath
shouts.desc: exhales a burst of fire dealing direct damage.

shouts.name: frost breath
shouts.desc: exhales a blizzard that damages and slows targets.

shouts.name: ice form
shouts.desc: encases enemies in solid ice, paralyzing them.

shouts.name: kyne's peace
shouts.desc: calms wild animals, removing their desire to fight or flee.

shouts.name: marked for death
shouts.desc: continuously drains an enemy's health and reduces their armor rating.

shouts.name: soul tear
shouts.desc: deals heavy damage, rips the soul out of a target, and reanimates the corpse.

shouts.name: slow time
shouts.desc: slows down time around you while keeping your speed intact.

shouts.name: storm call
shouts.desc: summons a thunderous lightning storm that strikes nearby targets.

shouts.name: summon durnehviir
shouts.desc: summons the undead dragon durnehviir from the soul cairn.

shouts.name: throw voice
shouts.desc: throws a voice to a distant point to distract enemies.

shouts.name: unrelenting force
shouts.desc: emits a powerful blast of force that staggers or hurls back targets.

shouts.name: whirlwind sprint
shouts.desc: propels you instantly forward at extreme and unstoppable speed.
